audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', that does not exist in Hwei's kit. His E-stance (Subject: Torment) is the crowd-control stance — its sub-spells are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. wants.foe also invents 'EE (Pool of Disturbance)', 'W (Fae-Blade)' walls, and an 'EW knock-up' Hwei does not have.
audit.why: Matches the packet defect: 'never names any of Hwei's abilities'. enemyKit confirms real names: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair — E carries hardCC/slow, not a knockup.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' throughout, and rewrote wants.foe to name real stance sub-spells instead of invented ones.

audit.why: Level 6 and first-item spikes correctly track R and Luden's timing.

edits.before: Referee the poke mirror with the barrier. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Referee the poke mirror with the barrier. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and out-chipping the 2v2 until your windows close.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and out-chipping the 2v2 until your windows close.

edits.before: - Lux vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Play when their answer is down — one clean window decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Lux vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Play when their answer is down — one clean window decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Prismatic Barrier answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment (E): 12s at rank 1, down to 10s maxed — all his CC lives on that stance, dodge it and the burst never chains. - Your W Prismatic Barrier answers exactly one disaster per 10-12s cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: All his CC lives on Subject: Torment (E) — dodge that stance's cast and the burst never chains. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: His Signature (P) needs two of your spells to detonate — land Q then E on the same target and the third hit is free damage.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Standing still while he charges a stance-swap cast — his abilities all telegraph on a delay, so moving denies the whole combo, not just one hit.

edits.before: Referee the poke mirror with the barrier. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Referee the poke mirror with the barrier. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): all his CC lives on that stance — dodge the cast and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: Poke you down with EE (Pool of Disturbance) slows and QQ orbs from max range
edits.after: Poke you down with Subject: Disaster (Q) sub-spells like Devastating Fire from max range

notes: Major fix: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is not a real Hwei ability — it does not appear in his kit (P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair). Replaced with Subject: Torment (E), the actual CC stance, everywhere it recurred. wants.foe also invented 'Pool of Disturbance', 'Fae-Blade' walls and an E-W knockup that are not in enemyKit's flags; rewrote those to name real stance sub-spells (Devastating Fire under Q, the W shield) grounded in the kit's flags.
